WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_count,
    SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS total
  FROM rating_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_count,
    rental_count / total AS share,
    AVG(rental_count / total) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM with_totals
)
SELECT 
  SUM(rental_count) AS combined_rented_films,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
